Responsible disclosure

Report vulnerabilities privately.

Do not place exploitable details, credentials, private packages, or proof-of-concept malware in public issues.

Include useful evidence

Provide the affected version and platform, component or endpoint, reproduction steps, impact, relevant logs with secrets removed, and whether the issue is currently being exploited.

Package emergencies

Identify the product, version, SHA-256, suspected behavior, and safe indicators. Staff can security-revoke an exact immutable version while preserving unrelated entitlements.

Current channel

Until a branded security mailbox and response SLA pass the launch gate, use the repository security policy and private reporting channel.

Open security policy ↗
Never send

Passwords, refresh tokens, service-role keys, signing private keys, or unrelated personal information.
